P01.rationale: A large, full-bleed portrait of the founder dominates the upper half of the page, serving as the clear human anchor.

P05.rationale: No case study client portraits are present; the page contains no named client images at any size.

P07.rationale: There is no press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial block anywhere on the page.

P10.rationale: The large stat numerals '100+' and '30-50%' are oversized within their card, but there are no ghost numerals or large decorative quote glyphs used as typographic ornaments.

P11.rationale: The stat cards show concrete numbers (100+ projects, 30-50% cost reduction) but there are no charts, before/after visuals, or cost-math diagrams—just text figures.

P12.rationale: The upper half is well-filled with the portrait and stat overlay, and the lower section has a headline, subhead, and bullet columns, but the overall density is moderate rather than truly magazine-packed.

P13.rationale: The dark, moody photographic background provides atmospheric texture behind the portrait, though the lower text section sits on a flat dark ground with no additional texture.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed portrait photo is darkened with a strong scrim/vignette, ensuring the overlaid name, headline, and body text in the lower section remain fully legible.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a professional studio shot of a real named individual, but the styling is generic enough (dark suit, neutral background) that it reads somewhat like a stock business photo.

N08.rationale: There is a noticeable empty zone in the mid-lower portrait area before the headline block begins, creating a mild dead-space gap, though it is not egregious.

N10.rationale: The tag pills at the top sit directly over the photo without a scrim, though their contrast is adequate; the main text areas below have sufficient dark backing so readability is not seriously compromised.
